The packaged Python/SymPy checker regenerates all algebraic identities.

value.rationale: The exact onset of spatial pattern-forming linear instability in a mass-conserving NPZD model under the minimally heterogeneous transport design (one exceptional diffusion rate) is an ecologically motivated quantitative threshold. Proving that only cos(2x) destabilizes throughout a sharp interval makes the information useful for detecting and designing single-wavelength instability, not just another arbitrary parameter witness. This is a narrow but natural full classification; no nonlinear pattern existence is claimed.
